description: This file defines the HashBasedPlacement class, which implements a placement strategy for activating grains on silos within Orleans. It uses hashing of grain identifiers to determine placement.

classes.name: HashBasedPlacement
classes.description: A sealed class implementing a placement strategy that assigns activations to silos based on hash in a stable, deterministic manner.

methods.name: Singleton
methods.description: A static property providing a singleton instance of the HashBasedPlacement class.
